entries.question: Book appointment
entries.answer:
To book an appointment at KGMU, please use one of the following methods:

**1. Online Portal (Recommended)**
*   Visit [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in)
*   Select State: **Uttar Pradesh**
*   Select Hospital: **King George's Medical University (KGMU)**
*   Click **'New Appointment'**, choose your department, and follow the steps to pay the ₹50 fee online.

**2. Mobile App**
*   Download the **ABHA** or **ORS** app from the KGMU Play Store.
*   Register with your mobile number and follow the same steps as the online portal.

**3. SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS in the format: **"APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>"** to **8887019134**.

**4. Walk-in (On-Site)**
*   Visit the OPD registration counter at KGMU.
*   You must have your **Aadhaar card** and an active mobile number to receive the OTP for registration.
*   The fee is ₹50.

**Important Information:**
*   **OPD Timings:** Mon–Fri 9:00 AM–1:00 PM | Sat 9:00 AM–12:00 PM | Closed Sundays.
*   **Pre-booking:** It is strongly recommended to book in advance to avoid long wait times.
*   **Outside-city patients:** Please ensure you carry a valid referral letter for your specific department.

For further assistance, you may call the KGMU helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.

*Note: I am not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details (like Aadhaar numbers or phone numbers) in this chat for your safety.*

4. **लारी कार्डियोलॉजी PRO कार्यालय:** आप लारी कार्डियोलॉजी के PRO ऑफिस से भी संपर्क कर सकते हैं, जिनका नंबर **9415099528** है।

To get information regarding admissions at King George's Medical University, please visit our official admissions page: https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php

This page contains details about the various undergraduate, postgraduate, and super-specialty courses offered, along with information on admission processes.

If you have a specific course in mind or need information about a particular entrance examination, please let me know!

entries.question: BSC nursing me admission kya process hai
entries.answer:
B.Sc. Nursing mein admission ke liye aap KGMU ki official website [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) par jaakar "Courses & Admission" section check kar sakte hain.

KGMU mein admission aam taur par entrance examination ke zariye hota hai. Aapko samay-samay par website ke **Admission Notice Board** ko check karte rehna chahiye taaki aap notification, eligibility criteria, aur application form ki dates miss na karein.

Admission se sambandhit jaankari ke liye aap is link par visit karein: [https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php)

I was created by Dr. Ayush Yadav.

entries.question: BSC nursing admission information number
entries.answer:
For information regarding B.Sc. Nursing admissions at KGMU, you can visit the official website at [https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php).

For direct inquiries, you may contact the university helpline at **0522-2258880** or the Registrar's Office at **0522-2253171**.
